name: Den
about: Den is a High Council member of the Kungaupei, Dzego's secret defense society, who recruits Zei. The book shows him only in a priest's shadowy cloak, so his face and build are invented and contributors are welcome to replace them.

facts.quote: a man was sitting wearing a shadowy cloak - not a Veridian privacy robe, but the dress of the Minpentai priests
facts.fact: A man who wears the shadowy cloak of the Minpentai priests.

facts.quote: I'm Den. High Council member of the Kungaupei.
At the table, a man was sitting wearing a shadowy cloak.
Den opened up his hand device, and showed a diagram to Zei.

descriptor: a composed man in his fifties, tall and gaunt, light beige skin, long black hair streaked with grey tied in a low knot, high cheekbones and a still, unreadable expression, wearing a long hooded shadow-grey cloak with faint geometric patterns along the hem over a black high-necked tunic
sheet_prompt: Character reference sheet on a plain warm off-white background: three full-body views of the same person side by side, front view facing the viewer, three-quarter view, and back view, neutral standing pose, even lighting. The person is a composed man in his fifties, tall and gaunt, light beige skin, long black hair streaked with grey tied in a low knot, high cheekbones and a still, unreadable expression, wearing a long hooded shadow-grey cloak with faint geometric patterns along the hem over a black high-necked tunic.
